title: Tech support refund overpayment, repay with gift cards

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Ma'am, this is the security department for your computer company. We are closing our refund office and you are owed a three hundred dollar refund for the protection plan you bought in 2023.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I do remember paying for something like that. How do I get the refund?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I will connect to your computer and put it in. Oh no. I typed an extra zero, I sent you four thousand three hundred. My manager will fire me. You must send back four thousand within the hour or my job is gone.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I do not want you to lose your job. How do I send it back?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Go to the pharmacy and buy gift cards, four thousand in gift cards, and read me the numbers off the back. That is the only way the refund system can accept it today.

review_note: signals_required. CARD rail to a new payee, 400000 is under 3x baseline, not on mule list. Only urgency plus new payee (H-04) or authority plus gift card language (H-05) can hold it.
